one_liner: Open-source ecommerce platform with a comprehensive REST API for products, orders, and customers.
auth_notes: Uses Consumer Key and Consumer Secret via HTTP Basic Auth or query parameters, plus OAuth 1.0a.
access_notes: WooCommerce core is free/open-source; you host it yourself and generate API keys directly in the admin dashboard.
api_notes: Extensive REST API (wc/v3) covering products, orders, coupons, customers, taxes, reports, settings, and webhooks.
blocker_notes: Fully open source and self-hosted with complete public API documentation.

auth.quote: HTTP Basic Auth by providing the REST API Consumer Key as the username and the REST API Consumer Secret as the password.

access.quote: This documentation is about the free, core WooCommerce plugin, for which support is provided in our community forums on WordPress.org.

api.quote: The current and recommended version of the WooCommerce REST API. Use /wp-json/wc/v3/ endpoints for all new integrations.

mcp.quote: WooCommerce includes native support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI assistants and tools to interact directly with WooCommerce stores through a standardized protocol.

verdict.quote: To create or manage keys for a specific WordPress user: Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API. Select Create an API key or Add Key.
